text: The Fed has reversed course and is now hiking rates back toward 4.00%+ while CPI remains sticky at 3.7-4.1% and the VIX sits elevated at 28.29 — this combination of tightening policy, persistent inflation, and high volatility means conditions favor caution over aggressive buying right now.

Sell IONQ — it's down 30% with a 67% drawdown from highs, burning cash with negative free cash flow, and in a rising-rate environment there is no margin of safety for a speculative, unprofitable company like this.
Trim PLTR because a PE of 64 is extremely vulnerable to compression when the Fed is actively hiking rates, and locking in some gains here reduces your exposure to the highest-valuation name you own.
Trim SPCX — a PE of 46.5 with negative free cash flow in a small position doesn't justify the risk when rates are heading higher and the market is punishing unprofitable, expensive names.

Add to ADBE — a PE of just 8.5 with strong free cash flow and profitability makes it one of your best risk/reward opportunities, and quality at a discount tends to hold up better when macro conditions are tough.
Add to GOOGL — despite the 19% loss, 15% revenue growth and reasonable valuation mean the pullback looks like a chance to lower your cost basis on a fundamentally sound business.
